title: chat-server: isPublic patch gate has no spec basis
description: permissions.rs MANAGE_SPACE doc, memory.rs (validate top-level metadata, ~L2298) and backend.rs (~L1336) state that §Space/set gates isPublic and isPubliclyPreviewable on manage_space. At jmap-chat-spec 91672c9 §Space/set L1256-1257 lists only name, description, iconBlobId as metadata patch keys; the draft names no patch key or permission for isPublic/isPubliclyPreviewable. Decide: raise a spec issue to add them under manage_space, or reject them as unknown keys. Found during JMAP-y3f2.10.
notes: DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-20: keep manage_space (matches chat-00 L812/L815). Spec fix: add isPublic, isPubliclyPreviewable to the §Space/set patch-key list (chat-00 L1256). Crate behaviour unchanged; only citations need fixing (done under JMAP-y3f2.17).
close_reason: Decided: keep manage_space; spec fixed in jmap-chat-spec 3227c0f; crate citations under JMAP-y3f2.17
